name: luminary-os
description: Local-first AI agent runtime and control interface

scripts.install:all: npm ci && npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm exec --prefix backend -- tsc --noEmit --project backend/tsconfig.tests.json && npm exec --prefix frontend -- tsc --noEmit --project frontend/tsconfig.json
